newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sunkyong in China trading house j/v.
newsitem.headline: Sunkyong in China trading house j/v.

text.p: Sunkyong Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Sunkyong Group, said on Thursday it had signed a deal with China's National Technical Import and Export Corp to open a joint venture trading house in Shanghai.
The joint-venture, Sino-Korea Trade Co Ltd, will be initially capitalised at $12.5 million. Sunkyong will hold a 49 percent stake.
A Sunkyong statement said the joint-venture will be the first of its kind in China and that the company was expected to start business from the end of 1996 or early 1997.
The joint venture will focus on imports and exports of petrochemicals along with light-industrial and steel goods.
